prompt:
Create one finished Cars24 blog cover image, 1000 x 650 final crop-safe composition, dark Cars24 theme. This is a balanced no-visible-text version: no headline, no body copy, no logo, no letters, no numbers, no UI text, no watermark anywhere.

Layout and balance: do NOT preserve an empty text-safe void from the title version. Recompose the full canvas around the photo hero and atmospheric pattern. Use a hero-led, centre-weighted composition: the team cutout sits large and calm across the centre-lower canvas, slightly right of centre but visually balanced across the whole width. Leave only natural breathing room, not a blank placeholder for text. The pattern and glow should flow through the left side as intentional atmosphere so every part of the image feels finished.

Canvas: Cars24 Brand Blue #4736FE as the dominant full-bleed canvas, with a subtle same-hue vertical/ambient gradient for premium depth. The canvas must read as bright Cars24 brand blue: not navy, not indigo, not black, not midnight blue, not dark violet, not dimmed AI-tech mode. Do not render the hex code as text.

Pattern: restrained but more full-canvas than the text version. White luminous Cars24 dot/wave fields, soft signal lines, small bokeh particles, and gentle operational flow curves move from lower-left through the centre toward upper-right behind the team. The pattern suggests controlled operational complexity becoming calm order. It must stay behind the photo cutout, never on top of the people or laptop. No warning icons, no alert triangles, no dashboard cards, no readable labels.

Photo hero: real photographic cutout, not illustration. Show a calm Cars24 operations/service team of three South Asian professionals maximum, wearing clean blue Cars24-style polos or workwear, gathered around one laptop/tablet at a simple table, focused and composed. They are the quiet reliable people bringing order to complexity. Natural skin tones, natural lighting, professional and reassuring expressions, not model-perfect. Render the team as a clean photographic cutout removed from its environment and placed directly on the Cars24 canvas, with a crisp visible white accent outline around the complete silhouette. Keep full heads, hands, laptop/tablet, table edge, and shoulders fully contained inside the safe zone; no cropping at edges.

Composition target: finished editorial key visual with no text. The hero should feel intentionally placed and balanced, not pushed to one side. Pattern, gradient, and bokeh should occupy the whole background in a controlled premium way. Preserve calm, reliability, and execution strength.

Do not include: any visible text, any logo, dramatic disaster scene, crash, fire, panic, emergency imagery, storm, war room cliche, dense dashboard, readable fake UI text, scattered warning icons, stock-photo office background, rectangular photo frame, embedded photo panel, illustration style, marble/statue subject, watermark.
